cases.sentence: Войдя к Лизе, он застал ее полулежащею в ее ___, в котором ее возили, когда она еще не могла ходить.
cases.explain: «прежнем кресле» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: A Little Demon Going in to Lise, he found her half reclining in the invalid-chair, in which she had been wheeled when she was unable to walk. She did not move to meet him, but her sharp, keen eyes were simply riveted on his face. There was a feverish look in her eyes, her face was pale and yellow. Alyosha was amazed at the change that had taken place in her in three days. She was positively thinner. She did not hold out her hand to him. He touched the thin, long fingers which lay motionless on her dress, then he sat down facing her, without a word.

cases.sentence: Только что сейчас рассуждала опять, в ___: как хорошо, что я вам отказала и не буду вашей женой.
cases.explain: «тридцатый раз» — after the preposition «в», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “On the contrary, I am very happy. I’ve only just been reflecting for the thirtieth time what a good thing it is I refused you and shall not be your wife. You are not fit to be a husband. If I were to marry you and give you a note to take to the man I loved after you, you’d take it and be sure to give it to him and bring an answer back, too. If you were forty, you would still go on taking my love-letters for me.”

cases.sentence: Я за вас выйду, а вы станьте мужиком, ___, у нас жеребеночек, хотите?
cases.explain: «настоящим мужиком» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: “That’s what your monk taught you. That’s not true. Let me be rich and all the rest poor, I’ll eat sweets and drink cream and not give any to anyone else. Ach, don’t speak, don’t say anything,” she shook her hand at him, though Alyosha had not opened his mouth. “You’ve told me all that before, I know it all by heart. It bores me. If I am ever poor, I shall murder somebody, and even if I am rich, I may murder someone, perhaps—why do nothing! But do you know, I should like to reap, cut the rye? I’ll marry you, and you shall become a peasant, a real peasant; we’ll keep a colt, shall we? Do you know Kalganov?”

cases.sentence: Что сделают на том свете за самый ___?
cases.explain: «большой грех» — after the preposition «за», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “You are awfully cross, because I don’t talk about holy things. I don’t want to be holy. What will they do to one in the next world for the greatest sin? You must know all about that.”

cases.sentence: — Вы злое принимаете за доброе: это ___, в этом ваша прежняя болезнь, может быть, виновата.
cases.explain: «минутный кризис» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “You take evil for good; it’s a passing crisis, it’s the result of your illness, perhaps.”

cases.explain: «дурные книги» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “And are you still reading nasty books?”

cases.sentence: — И у меня бывал этот ___, — вдруг сказал Алеша.
cases.explain: «самый сон» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: “I’ve had the same dream, too,” said Alyosha suddenly.

cases.explain: «ананасный компот» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: “Nice; I sometimes imagine that it was I who crucified him. He would hang there moaning and I would sit opposite him eating pineapple compote. I am awfully fond of pineapple compote. Do you like it?”

cases.sentence: Он вдруг засмеялся и сказал, что это в ___ хорошо.
cases.explain: «самом деле» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: “You know, when I read about that Jew I shook with sobs all night. I kept fancying how the little thing cried and moaned (a child of four years old understands, you know), and all the while the thought of pineapple compote haunted me. In the morning I wrote a letter to a certain person, begging him particularly to come and see me. He came and I suddenly told him all about the child and the pineapple compote. All about it, all, and said that it was nice. He laughed and said it really was nice. Then he got up and went away. He was only here five minutes. Did he despise me? Did he despise me? Tell me, tell me, Alyosha, did he despise me or not?” She sat up on the couch, with flashing eyes.

cases.sentence: Тот смотрел с ___, как вдруг почувствовал в своей правой руке письмо, маленькое письмецо, твердо сложенное и запечатанное.
cases.explain: «горестным недоумением» — after the preposition «с», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: And she almost forcibly pushed Alyosha out of the door. He looked at her with pained surprise, when he was suddenly aware of a letter in his right hand, a tiny letter folded up tight and sealed. He glanced at it and instantly read the address, “To Ivan Fyodorovitch Karamazov.” He looked quickly at Lise. Her face had become almost menacing.

cases.sentence: Тот смотрел с горестным недоумением, как вдруг почувствовал в своей ___ письмо, маленькое письмецо, твердо сложенное и запечатанное.
cases.explain: «правой руке» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: And she almost forcibly pushed Alyosha out of the door. He looked at her with pained surprise, when he was suddenly aware of a letter in his right hand, a tiny letter folded up tight and sealed. He glanced at it and instantly read the address, “To Ivan Fyodorovitch Karamazov.” He looked quickly at Lise. Her face had become almost menacing.
